verses.original: חֲזוֹן֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ אָמ֔וֹץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָזָ֔ה עַל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם בִּימֵ֨י עֻזִּיָּ֧הוּ יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·zō·wn yə·ša‘·yā·hū ḇen- ’ā·mō·wṣ ’ă·šer ḥā·zāh ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim bî·mê ‘uz·zî·yā·hū yō·w·ṯām ’ā·ḥāz yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: This is the vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem that Isaiah son of Amoz saw during the reigns of Uzziah Jotham Ahaz and Hezekiah kings of Judah

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְהַאֲזִ֣ינִי אֶ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּ֑ר בָּנִים֙ גִּדַּ֣לְתִּי וְרוֹמַ֔מְתִּי וְהֵ֖ם פָּ֥שְׁעוּ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū šā·ma·yim wə·ha·’ă·zî·nî ’e·reṣ kî Yah·weh dib·bêr bā·nîm gid·dal·tî wə·rō·w·mam·tî wə·hêm pā·šə·‘ū ḇî
verses.literal: Listen O heavens and give ear O earth for the LORD has spoken I have raised children and brought them up but they have rebelled against Me

verses.original: יָדַ֥ע שׁוֹר֙ קֹנֵ֔הוּ וַחֲמ֖וֹר אֵב֣וּס בְּעָלָ֑יו יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע עַמִּ֖י לֹ֥א הִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏa‘ šō·wr qō·nê·hū wa·ḥă·mō·wr ’ê·ḇūs bə·‘ā·lāw yiś·rā·’êl lō yā·ḏa‘ ‘am·mî lō hiṯ·bō·w·nān
verses.literal: The ox knows its owner and the donkey its master’s manger but Israel does not know My people do not understand

verses.original: ה֣וֹי׀ גּ֣וֹי חֹטֵ֗א עַ֚ם כֶּ֣בֶד עָוֺ֔ן זֶ֣רַע מְרֵעִ֔ים בָּנִ֖ים מַשְׁחִיתִ֑ים עָזְב֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה נִֽאֲצ֛וּ אֶת־ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נָזֹ֥רוּ אָחֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w gō·w ḥō·ṭê ‘am ke·ḇeḏ ‘ā·wōn ze·ra‘ mə·rê·‘îm bā·nîm maš·ḥî·ṯîm ‘ā·zə·ḇū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ni·’ă·ṣū ’eṯ- qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl nā·zō·rū ’ā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: Alas O sinful nation a people laden with iniquity a brood of evildoers children who act corruptly They have forsaken the LORD they have despised the Holy One of Israel and turned their backs on Him

verses.original: עַ֣ל מֶ֥ה תֻכּ֛וּ ע֖וֹד תּוֹסִ֣יפוּ סָרָ֑ה כָּל־ רֹ֣אשׁ לָחֳלִ֔י וְכָל־ לֵבָ֖ב דַּוָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al meh ṯuk·kū ‘ō·wḏ tō·w·sî·p̄ū sā·rāh kāl- rōš lā·ḥo·lî wə·ḵāl lê·ḇāḇ daw·wāy
verses.literal: Why . . . do you want more beatings Why do you keep rebelling Your head has a massive wound and your whole heart is afflicted

verses.original: מִכַּף־ רֶ֤גֶל וְעַד־ רֹאשׁ֙ אֵֽין־ בּ֣וֹ מְתֹ֔ם פֶּ֥צַע וְחַבּוּרָ֖ה וּמַכָּ֣ה טְרִיָּ֑ה לֹא־ זֹ֙רוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א חֻבָּ֔שׁוּ וְלֹ֥א רֻכְּכָ֖ה בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: mik·kap̄- re·ḡel wə·‘aḏ- rōš ’ên- bōw mə·ṯōm pe·ṣa‘ wə·ḥab·bū·rāh ū·mak·kāh ṭə·rî·yāh lō- zō·rū wə·lō ḥub·bā·šū wə·lō ruk·kə·ḵāh baš·šā·men
verses.literal: From the sole of your foot to the top of your head there is no soundness only wounds and welts and festering sores neither cleansed nor bandaged nor soothed with oil

verses.original: אַרְצְכֶ֣ם שְׁמָמָ֔ה עָרֵיכֶ֖ם שְׂרֻפ֣וֹת אֵ֑שׁ אַדְמַתְכֶ֗ם לְנֶגְדְּכֶם֙ זָרִים֙ אֹכְלִ֣ים אֹתָ֔הּ וּשְׁמָמָ֖ה כְּמַהְפֵּכַ֥ת זָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ar·ṣə·ḵem šə·mā·māh ‘ā·rê·ḵem śə·ru·p̄ō·wṯ ’êš ’aḏ·maṯ·ḵem lə·neḡ·də·ḵem zā·rîm ’ō·ḵə·lîm ’ō·ṯāh ū·šə·mā·māh kə·mah·pê·ḵaṯ zā·rîm
verses.literal: Your land is desolate your cities are burned with fire Foreigners devour your fields before you a desolation demolished by strangers

verses.original: וְנוֹתְרָ֥ה בַת־ צִיּ֖וֹן כְּסֻכָּ֣ה בְכָ֑רֶם כִּמְלוּנָ֥ה בְמִקְשָׁ֖ה כְּעִ֥יר נְצוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·wṯ·rāh ḇaṯ- ṣî·yō·wn kə·suk·kāh ḇə·ḵā·rem kim·lū·nāh ḇə·miq·šāh kə·‘îr nə·ṣū·rāh
verses.literal: And the Daughter of Zion is abandoned like a shelter in a vineyard like a shack in a cucumber field like a city besieged

verses.original: לוּלֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הוֹתִ֥יר לָ֛נוּ שָׂרִ֖יד כִּמְעָ֑ט כִּסְדֹ֣ם הָיִ֔ינוּ לַעֲמֹרָ֖ה דָּמִֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lū·lê Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ hō·w·ṯîr lā·nū śā·rîḏ kim·‘āṭ kis·ḏōm hā·yî·nū la·‘ă·mō·rāh dā·mî·nū
verses.literal: Unless the LORD of Hosts had left us a few survivors we would have become like Sodom we would have resembled Gomorrah

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה קְצִינֵ֣י סְדֹ֑ם הַאֲזִ֛ינוּ תּוֹרַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ עַ֥ם עֲמֹרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh qə·ṣî·nê sə·ḏōm ha·’ă·zî·nū tō·w·raṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ‘am ‘ă·mō·rāh
verses.literal: Hear the word of the LORD you rulers of Sodom listen to the instruction of our God you people of Gomorrah

verses.original: לָמָּה־ לִּ֤י רֹב־ זִבְחֵיכֶם֙ יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שָׂבַ֛עְתִּי עֹל֥וֹת אֵילִ֖ים וְחֵ֣לֶב מְרִיאִ֑ים וְדַ֨ם פָּרִ֧ים וּכְבָשִׂ֛ים וְעַתּוּדִ֖ים לֹ֥א חָפָֽצְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh- lî rōḇ- ziḇ·ḥê·ḵem yō·mar Yah·weh śā·ḇa‘·tî ‘ō·lō·wṯ ’ê·lîm wə·ḥê·leḇ mə·rî·’îm wə·ḏam pā·rîm ū·ḵə·ḇā·śîm wə·‘at·tū·ḏîm lō ḥā·p̄ā·ṣə·tî
verses.literal: What good to Me is your multitude of sacrifices says the LORD I am full from the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed cattle I take no delight in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats

verses.original: כִּ֣י תָבֹ֔אוּ לֵרָא֖וֹת פָּנָ֑י מִי־ בִקֵּ֥שׁ זֹ֛את מִיֶּדְכֶ֖ם רְמֹ֥ס חֲצֵרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯā·ḇō·’ū lê·rā·’ō·wṯ pā·nāy mî- ḇiq·qêš zōṯ mî·yeḏ·ḵem rə·mōs ḥă·ṣê·rāy
verses.literal: When you come to appear before Me who has required this of you this trampling of My courts

verses.original: לֹ֣א תוֹסִ֗יפוּ הָבִיא֙ מִנְחַת־ שָׁ֔וְא קְטֹ֧רֶת תּוֹעֵבָ֛ה הִ֖יא לִ֑י חֹ֤דֶשׁ וְשַׁבָּת֙ קְרֹ֣א מִקְרָ֔א לֹא־ אוּכַ֥ל אָ֖וֶן וַעֲצָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯō·w·sî·p̄ū hā·ḇî min·ḥaṯ- šāw qə·ṭō·reṯ tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh hî lî ḥō·ḏeš wə·šab·bāṯ qə·rō miq·rā lō- ’ū·ḵal ’ā·wen wa·‘ă·ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: Bring your worthless offerings no more your incense is detestable . . . to Me New Moons Sabbaths and convocations . . . I cannot endure iniquity in a solemn assembly

verses.original: חָדְשֵׁיכֶ֤ם וּמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם֙ שָׂנְאָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֔י הָי֥וּ עָלַ֖י לָטֹ֑רַח נִלְאֵ֖יתִי נְשֹֽׂא׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḏə·šê·ḵem ū·mō·w·‘ă·ḏê·ḵem śā·nə·’āh nap̄·šî hā·yū ‘ā·lay lā·ṭō·raḥ nil·’ê·ṯî nə·śō
verses.literal: I hate your New Moons and your appointed feasts They have become a burden to Me I am weary of bearing them

verses.original: וּבְפָרִשְׂכֶ֣ם כַּפֵּיכֶ֗ם אַעְלִ֤ים עֵינַי֙ מִכֶּ֔ם גַּ֛ם כִּֽי־ תַרְבּ֥וּ תְפִלָּ֖ה אֵינֶ֣נִּי שֹׁמֵ֑עַ יְדֵיכֶ֖ם דָּמִ֥ים מָלֵֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·p̄ā·riś·ḵem kap·pê·ḵem ’a‘·lîm ‘ê·nay mik·kem gam kî- ṯar·bū ṯə·p̄il·lāh ’ê·nen·nî šō·mê·a‘ yə·ḏê·ḵem dā·mîm mā·lê·’ū
verses.literal: When you spread out your hands in prayer I will hide My eyes from you even though you multiply your prayers I will not listen Your hands are covered with blood

verses.original: רַחֲצוּ֙ הִזַּכּ֔וּ הָסִ֛ירוּ רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם מִנֶּ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י חִדְל֖וּ הָרֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ra·ḥă·ṣū hiz·zak·kū hā·sî·rū rō·a‘ ma·‘al·lê·ḵem min·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·nāy ḥiḏ·lū hā·rê·a‘
verses.literal: Wash and cleanse yourselves Remove your evil deeds from My sight Stop doing evil

verses.original: לִמְד֥וּ הֵיטֵ֛ב דִּרְשׁ֥וּ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט אַשְּׁר֣וּ חָמ֑וֹץ שִׁפְט֣וּ יָת֔וֹם רִ֖יבוּ אַלְמָנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lim·ḏū hê·ṭêḇ dir·šū miš·pāṭ ’aš·šə·rū ḥā·mō·wṣ šip̄·ṭū yā·ṯō·wm rî·ḇū ’al·mā·nāh
verses.literal: Learn to do right seek justice and correct the oppressor Defend the fatherless and plead the case of the widow

verses.original: לְכוּ־ נָ֛א וְנִוָּֽכְחָ֖ה יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אִם־ יִֽהְי֨וּ חֲטָאֵיכֶ֤ם כַּשָּׁנִים֙ כַּשֶּׁ֣לֶג יַלְבִּ֔ינוּ אִם־ יַאְדִּ֥ימוּ כַתּוֹלָ֖ע כַּצֶּ֥מֶר יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū- nā wə·niw·wā·ḵə·ḥāh yō·mar Yah·weh ’im- yih·yū ḥă·ṭā·’ê·ḵem kaš·šā·nîm kaš·še·leḡ yal·bî·nū ’im- ya’·dî·mū ḵat·tō·w·lā‘ kaṣ·ṣe·mer yih·yū
verses.literal: Come now let us reason together says the LORD Though your sins are like scarlet they will be as white as snow though they are as red as crimson they will become like wool

verses.original: אִם־ תֹּאב֖וּ וּשְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם ט֥וּב הָאָ֖רֶץ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tō·ḇū ū·šə·ma‘·tem ṭūḇ hā·’ā·reṣ tō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: If you are willing and obedient you will eat the best of the land

verses.original: וְאִם־ תְּמָאֲנ֖וּ וּמְרִיתֶ֑ם חֶ֣רֶב תְּאֻכְּל֔וּ כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- tə·mā·’ă·nū ū·mə·rî·ṯem ḥe·reḇ tə·’uk·kə·lū kî pî Yah·weh dib·bêr
verses.literal: But if you resist and rebel you will be devoured by the sword For the mouth of the LORD has spoken

verses.original: אֵיכָה֙ הָיְתָ֣ה לְזוֹנָ֔ה קִרְיָ֖ה נֶאֱמָנָ֑ה מְלֵאֲתִ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֗ט צֶ֛דֶק יָלִ֥ין בָּ֖הּ וְעַתָּ֥ה מְרַצְּחִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ḵāh hā·yə·ṯāh lə·zō·w·nāh qir·yāh ne·’ĕ·mā·nāh mə·lê·’ă·ṯî miš·pāṭ ṣe·ḏeq yā·lîn bāh wə·‘at·tāh mə·raṣ·ṣə·ḥîm
verses.literal: See how the faithful . . . city has become a harlot She once was full of justice righteousness resided within her but now only murderers

verses.original: כַּסְפֵּ֖ךְ הָיָ֣ה לְסִיגִ֑ים סָבְאֵ֖ךְ מָה֥וּל בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kas·pêḵ hā·yāh lə·sî·ḡîm sā·ḇə·’êḵ mā·hūl bam·mā·yim
verses.literal: Your silver has become dross your fine wine is diluted with water

verses.original: שָׂרַ֣יִךְ סוֹרְרִ֗ים וְחַבְרֵי֙ גַּנָּבִ֔ים כֻּלּוֹ֙ אֹהֵ֣ב שֹׁ֔חַד וְרֹדֵ֖ף שַׁלְמֹנִ֑ים יָתוֹם֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁפֹּ֔טוּ וְרִ֥יב אַלְמָנָ֖ה לֹֽא־ יָב֥וֹא אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: śā·ra·yiḵ sō·wr·rîm wə·ḥaḇ·rê gan·nā·ḇîm kul·lōw ’ō·hêḇ šō·ḥaḏ wə·rō·ḏêp̄ šal·mō·nîm yā·ṯō·wm lō yiš·pō·ṭū wə·rîḇ ’al·mā·nāh lō- yā·ḇō·w ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Your rulers are rebels friends of thieves They all love bribes and chasing after rewards They do not defend the fatherless and the plea of the widow never comes before them

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן נְאֻ֤ם הָֽאָדוֹן֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲבִ֖יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ה֚וֹי אֶנָּחֵ֣ם מִצָּרַ֔י וְאִנָּקְמָ֖ה מֵאוֹיְבָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên nə·’um hā·’ā·ḏō·wn Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ă·ḇîr yiś·rā·’êl hō·w ’en·nā·ḥêm miṣ·ṣā·ray wə·’in·nā·qə·māh mê·’ō·wy·ḇāy
verses.literal: Therefore the Lord GOD of Hosts the Mighty One of Israel declares Ah I will be relieved of My foes and avenge Myself on My enemies

verses.original: וְאָשִׁ֤יבָה יָדִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְאֶצְרֹ֥ף כַּבֹּ֖ר סִיגָ֑יִךְ וְאָסִ֖ירָה כָּל־ בְּדִילָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·šî·ḇāh yā·ḏî ‘ā·la·yiḵ wə·’eṣ·rōp̄ kab·bōr sî·ḡā·yiḵ wə·’ā·sî·rāh kāl- bə·ḏî·lā·yiḵ
verses.literal: I will turn My hand against you I will thoroughly purge . . . your dross I will remove all your impurities

verses.original: וְאָשִׁ֤יבָה שֹׁפְטַ֙יִךְ֙ כְּבָרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה וְיֹעֲצַ֖יִךְ כְּבַתְּחִלָּ֑ה אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן יִקָּ֤רֵא לָךְ֙ עִ֣יר הַצֶּ֔דֶק קִרְיָ֖ה נֶאֱמָנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·šî·ḇāh šō·p̄ə·ṭa·yiḵ kə·ḇā·ri·šō·nāh wə·yō·‘ă·ṣa·yiḵ kə·ḇat·tə·ḥil·lāh ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên yiq·qā·rê lāḵ ‘îr haṣ·ṣe·ḏeq qir·yāh ne·’ĕ·mā·nāh
verses.literal: I will restore your judges as at first and your counselors as at the beginning After that . . . you will be called the City of Righteousness the Faithful City

verses.original: צִיּ֖וֹן בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט תִּפָּדֶ֑ה וְשָׁבֶ֖יהָ בִּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ṣî·yō·wn bə·miš·pāṭ tip·pā·ḏeh wə·šā·ḇe·hā biṣ·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: Zion will be redeemed with justice her repentant ones with righteousness

verses.original: וְשֶׁ֧בֶר פֹּשְׁעִ֛ים וְחַטָּאִ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וְעֹזְבֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִכְלֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·še·ḇer pō·šə·‘îm wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm yaḥ·dāw wə·‘ō·zə·ḇê Yah·weh yiḵ·lū
verses.literal: But rebels and sinners will together be shattered and those who forsake the LORD will perish

verses.original: כִּ֣י יֵבֹ֔שׁוּ מֵאֵילִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲמַדְתֶּ֑ם וְתַ֨חְפְּר֔וּ מֵהַגַּנּ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî yê·ḇō·šū mê·’ê·lîm ’ă·šer ḥă·maḏ·tem wə·ṯaḥ·pə·rū mê·hag·gan·nō·wṯ ’ă·šer bə·ḥar·tem
verses.literal: Surely you will be ashamed of the sacred oaks in which you have delighted you will be embarrassed by the gardens that you have chosen

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִֽהְי֔וּ כְּאֵלָ֖ה נֹבֶ֣לֶת עָלֶ֑הָ וּֽכְגַנָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ מַ֖יִם אֵ֥ין לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯih·yū kə·’ê·lāh nō·ḇe·leṯ ‘ā·le·hā ū·ḵə·ḡan·nāh ’ă·šer- ma·yim ’ên lāh
verses.literal: For you will become like an oak whose leaves are withered like a garden without water

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה הֶחָסֹן֙ לִנְעֹ֔רֶת וּפֹעֲל֖וֹ לְנִיצ֑וֹץ וּבָעֲר֧וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֛ם יַחְדָּ֖ו וְאֵ֥ין מְכַבֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh he·ḥā·sōn lin·‘ō·reṯ ū·p̄ō·‘ă·lōw lə·nî·ṣō·wṣ ū·ḇā·‘ă·rū šə·nê·hem yaḥ·dāw wə·’ên mə·ḵab·beh
verses.literal: The strong man will become tinder and his work will be a spark both will burn together with no one to quench the flames
